samples_reviewed.question_text: Use base-10 blocks to show the number 1410.
Use base-10 blocks to show the number 5688.
What number is marked on the number line?
What number is marked on the number line?
What number do the blocks show?
Move the dot to show 9630 on the number line.
Move the dot to show 6795 on the number line.
What number is marked on the number line?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both required representations are present, but the number-line items demand precision a picture cannot carry. Choosing among 9522, 9520, 9523 and 9521 means resolving consecutive integers on a drawn line, and the same one-apart option sets recur on the other number-line samples, so the pictorial model cannot actually decide the answer.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Every sampled value is a four-digit number between the 1000s and the 9000s. Nothing falls below 1000, nothing reaches 10 000 itself, and no value carries a zero in an interior place, which is the hardest case for a base-10 block model since a whole place must be shown as empty.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Base-10 blocks and a number line are the two models Grade 3 Quarter 1 uses for this range, and no sample asks the pupil to do anything with the numbers beyond representing or reading them.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Two distinct models are used and both directions of the representation are exercised: building a model from a given numeral, as with the base-10 block and dot-placement items, and naming the numeral a shown model represents.

competency_alignment.rationale: Variation is entirely in which model is used and which direction the translation runs, both of which are the competency's own dimensions rather than an imported arithmetic axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All sampled values sit between roughly 1400 and 9630, so the stated boundary of 10 000 is never reached, and the lower part of the range the competency covers is not sampled at all. One block item also offers 21 against three four-digit options, a choice no pupil needs the model to eliminate.
